debrief.verdict_sentence: Outside your limits. With 40 % [T6] in NVIDIA, this mix fell 34.5 % [T10] from its high in 2022, past the 15 % floor [T3] your capacity sets.

sentences.text: Daily prices from Nov 2021 to Nov 2026 for every line you own, in Canadian dollars, replayed on $600,000 [T2].
Your mix as it is fell at most 10.6 % [T9].
Your floor is a hard limit, and the move broke it twice: a $207,000 [T11] fall in 2022, then a 16.9 % [T12] drop, $101,400 [T13], in April 2025.
Tariff shocks like the one you asked about cost it up to 9.0 % [T16], beyond the 7.5 % [T17] shock limit.
This is one history, not a forecast.
NVIDIA would carry 86 % [T18] of the ups and downs, so one line decides the outcome.
A smaller move: in this history your floor breaks above 8 % [T19] NVIDIA.
The move also grew 25.2 % [T15] a year against 8.7 % [T14].
Ending higher does not mean your limits held.
